A DEFECT IS NOT A QUESTION. A DOCUMENT IS NOT A QUESTION. A CORRIDOR BEING NAMED IS NOT AN ANSWER. THE THIRTY FINDINGS THE CLOSE MADE IN THE CHAPTERS ARE DEFECTS AND ARE NOT AMONG THESE THIRTY-FIVE AND ADD NONE.**

### THE THREE THAT CARRY THE MOST WEIGHT, AND WHY

**1. WHOSE ORDER IT IS. Asked four times across the series, answered never, named once without being asked, and not asked a fifth time in this volume and not named. The schedule came out of the standing willow at `chapter-0386.md` in full: nineteen places, what against each, when against each, eight of them with a day and an hour as well as a season, and it says what and when and has no name anywhere on it, no office and no subject. The sentence that says this is a limit of the object and not a refusal of the question was said once, in a room, at `workspace/volume-08/batch-0003/chapter-0372.md:47`, and the chapter says it is not going to be said again in that building. At `chapter-0384.md:45` the man of about thirty-one of Silling had it in his mouth at about the sixth hour and did not put it, and four people could see that he had it and none of them said so. **STILL OPEN. A CHAPTER MAY NOT ANSWER IT AND THE VOLUME 08 CLOSE DID NOT.**

**2. WHETHER THE TELLING IS STILL GOING ON. Untouchable, and untouched, for five volumes now. The word *telling* occurs in the forty-nine chapters only as an ordinary verb and *still going on* occurs nowhere in them. **STILL OPEN. NO CHAPTER MAY SAY ANYTHING ABOUT IT AND THE VOLUME 08 CLOSE SAID NOTHING ABOUT IT.**

**3. WHAT A RECORD IS FOR, WHEN THE ONLY PERSON WHO TOOK IT IS NOT A WITNESS TO HIMSELF ANY MORE. Opened, worked hard, and left open, and the volume says so itself in the last chapter. The page he took the day on is in a stack in the order it was used and nobody moved it to the top. His own answer in his own words is at `chapter-0390.md:53` and it is that a holding keeps a true thing and that keeping it and being able to use it are not the same operation and that a refusal to use it is not a failure of the work. **STILL OPEN, AND THE ONE ANSWER ON THE PAGE IS AN ANSWER ABOUT WHAT A HOLDING DOES, NOT ABOUT WHAT A RECORD IS FOR.**

### THE THIRTY-TWO OTHERS, AS THEY STAND, ONE LINE EACH

**4. The corridor in the pan.** Open, and open is not a road, and naming it at twenty-eight sites is not answering it. The sheet claiming it is in a drawer face up and is correct in every particular and cannot be put down and does not let anything out. **Still open.**
**5. The seed vault of forty households under four hundred yards off.** Not recovered. `chapter-0392.md:39`: *has not come up, and nobody has been down and nobody is going to be.* **Still open.**
**6. The ring of bare ground inside the eleven acres, bare in its eleventh year.** Not walked, not measured, not crossed, not priced by walking it, not explained, twenty-four negations, and no dimension on any page, and not one of the nine put a foot in it. **Still open.**
**7. Who speaks for the eleven acres.** Six answers in four years and none of them is an answer, and a seventh wrong answer is put in a room at `chapter-0368.md` and the chapter says none of the seven is an answer, and there is no eighth. **Still open.**
**8. The unit of the two numbers the woman of about thirty-eight of Marden says out loud.** Not known, entered as not known, and not supplied at any of the seventeen chapters in which she appears. **Still open.**
**9. Why the middle came down, and which rate is the true one.** Unreconciled, and the volume does not use the rate and states nothing about the total. **Still open.**
**10. The sixth blank column, and what the seventh counts besides readings.** Six columns headed nothing for four years at every one of thirty-seven sites and no heading written on one. ## THE VOLUME 10 BATCH 0001 VERIFICATION, ADDED BY THE REPAIR THAT REVIEWED IT, AND IT GOVERNS OVER EVERY SECTION OF THIS FILE ABOVE IT

**WHAT THIS IS.** A writer phase was dispatched onto `workspace/volume-10/batch-0001/PROMPT.md`, a batch whose ten chapters were already written, measured, reviewed and repaired.
